title: Amusement Park Chaos Cracks the Code — Part 4

series.summary: Rentaro and Nano embark on their one-day date at the amusement park. Despite Nano attempting to quantify roller coaster velocity and haunted house mechanics, Rentaro’s genuine warmth and park snacks begin melting her icy exterior until she admits the day was surprisingly fun.

segments.voiceover_text: Meeting outside the vibrant amusement park, Rentaro immediately snaps a smiling souvenir photo together, deeply baffling her analytical mind.
Aboard the towering roller coaster, Nano measures wind velocity while Rentaro screams his absolute lungs out right beside her.
Through spooky haunted houses and chaotic carnival games, he faithfully shields her from every single manufactured jump scare and trap.
Resting together on a quiet bench, Nano samples sweet park treats, tasting genuine culinary pleasure for the very first time.
As sunset falls across the park, she softly confesses that this joyful afternoon far exceeded all her rigorous mathematical expectations.
